connector.name: Cathedral - Persistent Memory for AI Agents
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory and drift detection for AI agents across session restarts.
connector.summary: Hosted at cathedral-ai.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package cathedral-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ailife1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: CATHEDRAL_SANITISE
